question: Will regular gasoline in Japan average more than ¥170.1 a litre in the Mon 2 Nov 2026 survey?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Japan’s energy agency (ANRE) reports a national average retail price for regular gasoline strictly above ¥170.1 per litre (the 2026-10-26 figure) in its weekly survey for 2026-11-02, as stated on its fuel price support site.
- "No": That national average for the 2026-11-02 survey is ¥170.1 or lower.

Clarifications:
- Use the retail price (小売価格), not the "price without subsidy" (補助なし価格) shown alongside it.
- current_graph.pdf is replaced each week; it states the survey date and the price to one decimal place.
- If a public holiday moved the survey off Monday, use that same week’s survey.
